{"id":"mimid-1wgh.4.81.16","title":"Decision: mimi-mls sets required_capabilities for did_webvh groups (narrows mimid-1wgh.4.33)","description":"draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-00 §The Heads Extension: "A GroupContext that contains did_webvh_heads MUST also contain a required_capabilities extension that lists did_webvh_heads in extension_types and did_webvh in credential_types". mimid decision mimid-1wgh.4.33 leaves required_capabilities to the protocol layer, and Member::create takes no required_capabilities.

Chosen: mimi-mls sets it. Member::create with a did_webvh identity puts the creator's record and a required_capabilities listing did_webvh_heads and did_webvh in the first GroupContext; any Commit that sets the record (didwebvh::with_heads) keeps an existing required_capabilities and adds the two types if missing, keeping its other entries. Receivers refuse a GroupContext with the record and without those entries (DidWebvhError::RequiredCapabilities). This narrows decision mimid-1wgh.4.33 for did_webvh groups only.

Observation for -01: listing did_webvh in required_capabilities.credential_types means every member must list did_webvh, and by §The Heads Extension every client listing it MUST implement the rules. RFC 9420 §7.2 already requires every member to support every credential type in use, so even without the required_capabilities rule a basic-only client cannot share a group with a did_webvh leaf. §Negotiation's "a group that also admits basic or x509 credentials" therefore means groups whose basic/x509 members still implement this draft.

new_value: {"notes":"2026-11-18, bead mimid-1wgh.4.81.34: superseded for the record. With the record an app_data_dictionary component (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.33), mimi-mls writes no required_capabilities and the did_webvh_heads extension type is gone. Member::create with a did_webvh identity, and the first Commit that sets the record, put the record component into the GroupContext app_components list (mls-extensions-11 §5), which makes every member list it; receivers refuse a GroupContext with the record whose app_components does not name it (DidWebvhError::HeadsNotListed, replacing RequiredCapabilities). The -01 observation about mixed groups stands (RFC 9420 §7.2)."}
